query: SELECT id AS "id!: String", json_quote(json_extract(payload, '$.record.envelope.routerTime')) AS "router_time!: String" FROM record_identities WHERE kind = 'post' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.placement.kind') = 'project' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.actor.kind') = 'human' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.placement.projectId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.actor.humanId') = ? ORDER BY id
